added.name: Ascenix
added.long_description:
Ascenix is the all-in-one incident platform that turns unstructured EHR data into automated reporting, reimbursement recovery, compliance flagging, and clinical insight. We’re already live in 50 homes and scaling across North America. We connect to systems like PointClickCare and analyze the notes nurses already write, adapting to any note structure and any compliance or reporting requirement.

We help teams identify documentation gaps, uncover missed revenue opportunities and spot emerging resident risks, while reducing time spent reviewing charts and building spreadsheets. Our goal is to improve residents’ quality of life by helping care homes reach their full clinical, financial and operational potential.
added.one_liner: Clinical intelligence layer for skilled nursing facilities.

long_description.before:
Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data - the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web.
long_description.after: Firecrawl gives your AI agents web data and beyond. Search and scrape the web, then access more sources through Alexandria’s library of data providers and specialized indexes. With more data to draw from, your AI agents can dig deeper and find answers that would otherwise stay out of reach. Use Firecrawl through your AI tools or build with our web data API.

one_liner.after: Give your AI agents web data and beyond.

long_description.before:
Precip uses AI to make hyperlocal weather observations. We’re started with the most important dimension of weather: rain. For example, one of our customers uses Precip daily to make sure their heavy trucks won’t get stuck in muddy fields.

Our highly rated mobile app is the best way to see rain and snow totals anywhere.
long_description.after:
Precip uses deep-learning to make the most accurate rain forecast in the US. We started by using high-resolution radar to measure what actually fell, and built our minute-by-minute forecast on top of it. The result is a forecast that's 85% more accurate than Apple Weather and 52% more accurate than Google Weather, plus an API (with MCP) for developers.

Our highly rated mobile app is the best way to see rain and snow totals anywhere.

long_description.before: The fastest persistent computer for agents. Host long-running, stateful agents that never sleep in <50ms.
long_description.after:
Dedalus Labs builds persistent compute for AI agents. Our flagship product, Dedalus Machines, gives agents isolated computers where they can run software, keep files and state, and do useful work over time.

We build across virtualization, distributed storage, networking, scheduling, and orchestration. Our goal is to make persistent compute dependable and straightforward to use through APIs and developer tools, so developers can build agents that work with real software and maintain a working environment across sessions.

long_description.before:
Ritivel is an AI-native workspace for regulatory and medical writing teams at life sciences companies. Our AI agents draft CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs in minutes instead of weeks, helping drugs reach patients faster.

Every month a drug is delayed from reaching the market costs pharma companies ~$45M in lost revenue and more importantly, delays treatment for thousands of patients who need it. Yet regulatory teams are stuck in a painful, months-long process: synthesizing thousands of pages of clinical data, hunting through SharePoint folders for the right documents, chasing colleagues for missing inputs, and manually drafting submissions.

Ritivel deploys AI agents that transform how regulatory teams work. Our agents generate comprehensive first drafts directly in Microsoft Word, following FDA formatting requirements and pulling from your existing clinical data and prior submissions. Every data point includes citations linked back to the original source, so reviewers can verify with one click. Connected to SharePoint and Veeva, our agents automatically source the right documents. Integrated with Outlook, they handle reminder emails and follow-ups automatically.

We're engineers who previously built AI copilots at Microsoft Research. After 50+ conversations with pharma professionals, we discovered the critical bottleneck in regulatory submissions and built Ritivel to solve it.
long_description.after:
TensorTest (formerly Ritivel) builds evaluations, reinforcement-learning environments, and expert training data for AI labs developing creative agents, starting with video editing.

An agent can produce a valid video file without delivering an edit that meets the client’s brief. Labs need reliable ways to measure creative quality, identify failures, and give agents feedback they can learn from.

Our first benchmark, TimelineBench, gives agents client video-editing jobs with raw footage, audio, and a brief. It evaluates the finished work using a verifier calibrated on thousands of blind judgments from professional editors. Across 16 agents we tested, the best passed only 26.8% of jobs. Most failures came down to creative craft rather than broken output.

We offer labs private evaluations to identify where their models fail, training environments that use our verifier’s scores as rewards, and expert-created training data, including professional editing demonstrations, preference pairs, and grading rubrics. These offerings connect evaluation to training: identify what an agent gets wrong, provide feedback on its attempts, and supply examples of better work.

Our team comes from IIT Bombay and has trained language models and built agentic systems at Microsoft Research.

one_liner.after: Evals, RL environments and training data for creative tasks

long_description.before:
Shepherd Robotics builds general purpose robots for skilled physical work across AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Our robots are powered by robot foundation models and use modular, flexible hardware designed to adapt to different environments and tasks.
We train our systems on a combination of real world and simulation data so they can learn complex manipulation skills and generalize across workflows. We are starting with tasks such as data center construction and operations, cable and wire manufacturing, wire harness assembly, kitting, and factory packaging, where traditional automation struggles with variability, dexterity, and changing environments.
